name: python-gcd
title: Gcd Minimum Spanning Tree
blurb: gcd (Euclid) and lcm over small positive integers: the result equals the shipped oracle (trial division) on every seeded pair, the remainder is taken until it vanishes, and coprime reports shared divisors; non-positive or oversized inputs are named, never divided.
default_description: A spanning-tree walker whose total is the enumeration oracle's minimum on every small undirected graph, whose witness ledger tells the truth, and whose tree spans every node exactly once.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: the remainder is taken until it vanishes, then the other side
